evidence.claim: Dolder dal 1898 affianca produttori di materie prime e trasformatori di materie plastiche operando nei principali mercati europei.
evidence.quote: Since 1898, we have been delivering effective solutions to our customers and suppliers. || We operate in the most important European markets, ensuring proximity and performance where it matters most. || As a modern company and strategic partner to raw material producers and plastics processors, we combine a long-standing tradition with forward-thinking expertise.
